name: weixing-service
description: Express Node.js 后端服务，管理参数数据、远程重启设备和串口通信

scripts.pkg:win: npm run build && pkg -t node18-win-x64 -o dist/weixing-service-win.exe .
scripts.pkg:mac: npm run build && pkg -t node18-macos-x64 -o dist/weixing-service-mac .
scripts.pkg:linux: npm run build && pkg -t node18-linux-x64 -o dist/weixing-service-linux .
scripts.migrate:images: ts-node -e "import('./src/scripts/migrateImages').then(m => m.runImageMigration(true).then(() => console.log('图片迁移完成')).catch(e => {console.error('图片迁移失败:', e); process.exit(1)}))"
scripts.db:vacuum: ts-node -e "import('./src/scripts/vacuumDb').then(m => m.runVacuum(true).then(() => console.log('数据库VACUUM完成')).catch(e => {console.error('数据库VACUUM失败:', e); process.exit(1)}))"
scripts.db:init: ts-node -e "import('./src/services/db-setup-postgres').then(m => m.initializePostgresDB().then(() => console.log('数据库初始化完成')).catch(e => {console.error('数据库初始化失败:', e); process.exit(1)}))"
